help.title: Frequently Asked Actions
help.subtitle: Open the accordion item you need. Each has a summary, step-by-step guide, and a quick link.

classroom.title: Where can I see my classroom?
classroom.summary: View which classroom you are registered to from the Classroom page.
steps: Click Student > Classroom in the menu.
See your registered classroom(s) in the table.
Use search to quickly filter by classroom name.

assignments.title: How do I see my assignments?
assignments.summary: See all assignments for your class with task, subject, teacher and deadline.
steps: Click Student > Assignments in the menu.
Check task, subject, class, deadline and teacher info in the table.
Use search to filter by subject or task name.

schedule.title: Where is my timetable?
schedule.summary: Track planned lessons for your class in the Schedule page.
steps: Click Student > Schedule in the menu.
See lesson, class, date, time and teacher info in the table.
Use search to filter by lesson or class name.

classroom.title: Where do I see the classes I'm responsible for?
classroom.summary: Review the classes you teach and their students on the Classroom screen.
steps: Click Academy > Classroom (Teacher) in the menu.
See class name, capacity and enrolled students in the list.
Use search to filter by class name.

schedule.title: How do I view my schedule?
schedule.summary: Check your assigned lessons with date/time and class info.
steps: Click Academy > Schedule in the menu.
Review lesson, class, date and time in the table.
Use search to filter by lesson or class; pagination for navigation.

assignments.title: How do I add/manage assignments?
assignments.summary: Define assignments for your classes, upload files, and set deadlines.
steps: Click Academy > Assignments in the menu.
Open the Add modal, enter task, subject, class, deadline, file.
Save Changes; see current assignments in the table.

register.title: How can I sign up?
register.summary: If you don't have an account, contact admin or fill the request form.
steps: Click the signup request or contact link on the login screen.
Provide name, email, and desired role.
Once approved, you can log in.

support.title: How do I get support during signup?
support.summary: Reach support or admin if you face issues with signup or access.
steps: Send your message from the Feedbacks page.
Check your email; follow the instructions when you receive a reply.
Reach out again if needed until the process is done.

student.title: How to create a student?
student.summary: Open student record in admin and add to class.
steps: Go to Students.
Click Add.
Fill student info and select class.
Save Changes and verify the student is in class.

teacher.title: How to add a teacher?
teacher.summary: Create new teacher account and assign subjects.
steps: Go to Users or Teachers.
Use Add to create the user/teacher card.
If needed, use Edit in Teachers to assign subject/lesson.

lesson.title: How to create a lesson and assign a teacher?
lesson.summary: Open a new lesson and link the teacher.
steps: Go to Manage > Lessons.
Click Add, enter lesson name and category.
Pick the teacher from the dropdown.
Save Changes.

classroom.title: How to create a classroom and add students?
classroom.summary: Create a classroom and add existing students.
steps: Go to Manage > Classroom and click Add.
Enter class name and capacity, Save Changes.
In Students page, Add the student to the classroom.

schedule.title: How to add schedule sessions?
schedule.summary: Pair lesson, teacher and class to create schedule entries.
steps: Go to Manage > Schedule.
Add day, time, lesson and class.
Save Changes; verify in the table.

assignment.title: How to add assignments and upload files?
assignment.summary: Create assignments for teachers/classes and upload files.
steps: Click Add in Assignments.
Enter title, lesson, class, deadline, optionally attach file.
Save Changes.
